title: Dispatcher notification
description: A notification inside the dispatcher. The text in <news> is rendered from it only when it is delivered. detail depends on kind. Only these keys.

at.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, a real calendar date and time.

issue.description: Issue id, when the notification is about an issue.

time.description: UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, a real calendar date and time.

id.description: A ledger issue id: no /, \ or :, and not . or ...

pr.description: URL of a pull request; owner and repo are printable ASCII without /.

asked.description: kind asked: from {"question": n, "status": "open"}, filled from the question JSON.

answered.description: kind answered: from {"question": n, "status": "answered"} written outside a herdr terminal (by not starting with terminal:), that is the owner's answer from the pane. Delivered to the Chief of Staff, who passes it on.

kind.description: As in question.json (questions.yaml when there is no question JSON).

ready.description: kind ready: an issue that became ready since last time (person issues excluded).

routine.description: Routine that added the issue, if any.

abandoned.description: Issues it waited for (after) whose deliverable is a PR and that became done without the PR merged, if any.

unchecked.description: Issues it waited for whose PR could not be checked as merged or not, if any.

review-requested.description: kind review-requested: the dispatcher started a reviewer for review_request.

gate.description: kind gate: the result of `andon gate` run by the dispatcher.

decision.description: As in the gate record. behind without record: the gate could not decide on a stacked issue, which waits on the previous PR all the same.

unsent.description: Only with decision fix: the worker's address the reasons could not be sent to (its terminal is gone). The notification is then delivered to the Chief of Staff.

no_agent.description: Only with decision fix: the issue has no worker (agent is empty), so the reasons were sent to no one. The notification is then delivered to the Chief of Staff.

merged.description: kind merged: the dispatcher merged and finished the issue, or (by: person) found that a person merged an issue in review and finished it. held: it did not finish, and why.

by.description: Only when a person merged on GitHub (absent when the dispatcher merged).

held.description: Why the dispatcher did not finish the issue (an open question not from the gate, or finish failed).

hold.description: kind hold: the issue whose answer the Chief of Staff held this issue's pull request for is done, and the hold is still there. The hold is not released by itself (andon issue unhold). Notified once, from the done row of the reason issue.

reason.description: The issue the hold names (issue.yaml hold), now done.

closed.description: kind closed: the pull request of an issue in review was closed without merging. Not finished; notified once.

signal.description: kind signal: a signal of weight now seen for the first time in an episode (copied from the signal record, schema/signal.schema.json).

title.description: As in the signal record. Untrusted: rendered inside the untrusted fence.

release.description: As in the signal record, only when the record has one: for github-ci, the commit of the run where the failure began. The Chief of Staff looks up its pull request as the candidate breaking change.

corrections.description: kind corrections: the dispatcher could not collect a finished issue's corrections.json (after one retry) and did not write it.

impact.description: kind impact: from `andon issue impact` after an issue's PR was merged. Only the running issues it may affect; the Chief of Staff judges. When the facts could not be collected, only pr and error.

error.description: Why the dispatcher gave up collecting the facts (after retries).

issues.description: Running issues in the same repo that conflict, overlap, are referenced by the brief, miss moved check places (review issues), or could not be read.

conflict.description: git merge-tree of the branch and the merge commit conflicts.

brief_refs.description: Merged files named in the issue's brief (at most 20).

checks_moved.description: Check places (tests, workflows, Go tests; the gate's definition) the merged PR changed and the branch does not contain yet (at most 20). Absent in notifications written before it.

error.description: Why the facts could not be read.

terminal.description: kind blocked, error, finished, stalled: the terminal host's state. No screen text.

status_ms.description: status_ms of the terminal host: Unix time in milliseconds when it entered this state.

resumed.description: kind resumed: the agent's terminal of a doing issue was gone, and the dispatcher ran andon issue resume once and started it again from its session.

agent.description: Address of the terminal resume started.

from.description: Address of the terminal that was gone.

estimate.description: kind estimate: the worked time of a doing issue (waits excluded) went over its estimate times stage. Once per stage; nothing is sent to the agent.

worked_minutes.description: Worked minutes, waits excluded, rounded down.

stage.description: Times the estimate it went over.

sign.description: Signs of being stuck, counted with git in the issue's worktree: no-commit (no commit for the estimate's minutes), large-diff (over 500 changed lines, tests excluded). Only when there is one.

memory.description: kind memory: the cell's auto memory files (the index MEMORY.md excluded) went over the line. Once until the count falls back to the line or below. No issue.

line.description: The line it went over (count > line).

idle.description: kind idle: slots stayed free at two looks in a row (idle_minutes apart), and some issue stayed startable unstarted, some routine was fired, or kanban lint found new problems. No issue.

free.description: Free slots at this look (andon waiting list's slots.free).

unstarted.description: Issues in kanban ready at the previous look and at this one, told once each (owner issues and reviewers' children excluded).

fired.description: Names of the routines fired at this look (kanban routine run), in the order fired.

lint.description: Number of kanban lint problems, when they differ from the ones told before; else 0.
